_estimator: newline_margin_freeze.margin(prefix=[], nl=t), imported; batched for whole vocabularies and checked against the imported one-at-a-time path below

_determinism_check.note: re-measured through the same path at the same batch size

_oracle_check.note: the batched path vs the imported one-at-a-time estimator. Bits must agree; margins need not be bit-identical because batching changes the floating-point reduction order. Doubles as the batch-invariance diagnostic: argmax is brittle at near-ties.

_coverage_note: every token of this model's own vocabulary was measured
_margin_scale: 1e-4 logits, stored as integers; see the comment in measure(). A nonzero margin never rounds to zero, so sign(margins_e4) == the self-continuation bit exactly, and self_continuing_ids is computed from the unrounded values.

_analysis_provenance.note: sha256 of the analysis source at write time, plus the repo-local import closure. If any of these does not match the file on disk, the analysis was produced by a different version of the code -- re-run it before reading the numbers (issue #38; the imports half closes the same hole one level down the import graph). Third-party package versions are NOT covered.
